actions.label: Extended network discovery
actions.meaning: The owner explicitly chooses whether their connections may contribute anonymous third-degree discovery. Accepted active direct connections can view their eligible connection list regardless of this setting. Private contact details and information grants are unaffected. Extended discovery starts off.

navigation_prerequisites: The signed-in owner has loaded their saved preference.

execution_target.reason: The owner chooses extended network discovery using the visible switch after reviewing the disclosure.
